comment_regular: NiBlendAccumTransformInterpolator virtual transform update (+0x4C). One item uses the accumulation fast path. With multiple items, normalizes blend state, updates each nonzero-weight 0x18-byte item using either caller time or its per-item time +0x14, then evaluates the accumulated transform. Caches requested time at +0x08.
